en_title: How Rockstar Made Every NPC Feel Alive in GTA 6
cn_title: Rockstar如何让《GTA 6》中的每个NPC都感觉鲜活
opus_summary: Rockstar开发人员介绍了《GTA6》中NPC的塑造方式：团队为世界设定深入的背景故事，通过实地考察捕捉当地生活，并运用新技术呈现人物的外观和动作。同时，团队还需考虑不同体型角色的互动，以及玩家介入各种事件后可能产生的结果。

paragraphs.en: Game developers often refer to their open world cities as characters due to the sheer craftsmanship involved in building out a believable, diverse playspace for the player with its own districts, history, and architecture. This is truer for GTA 6 than most games, but what makes Leonida really feel alive — outside of the puddles of bin juice, the regional-specific cop cars, and mapped out power grid — are the people who live there.
paragraphs.cn: 游戏开发者经常将开放世界中的城市称为角色，因为要为玩家打造一个可信、多样，拥有各自街区、历史和建筑的游玩空间，需要投入大量心血。相比大多数游戏，《GTA 6》更是如此，但除了地上的一滩滩垃圾渗液、具有地域特色的警车和规划完整的电网之外，真正让Leonida感觉鲜活的是生活在那里的人们。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 feels like a massive evolution in what it means to be a non-player character (NPC) because there’s an emphasis on the “C” — they’re actually characters in their own right. NPCs don’t just all look unique — with body types, skin, dress style, and hair making them stand apart — they have their own personalities and temperaments. Start a fight with one NPC and they might fight back, while another runs away. One could start a fight by slapping you, another might flick their cigarette at you or tip their drink over your head. Passersby can cheer the fight on, flee, or get involved. Some stop after a single punch knocks sense into them, while others swing until they’re out cold.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA 6》让人感觉非玩家角色（NPC）的含义有了巨大的进化，因为它强调了其中的「C」——他们本身就是实实在在的角色。NPC不仅外貌各不相同，体型、肤色、穿衣风格和发型都让他们彼此有别，他们还有各自的性格和脾气。跟一个NPC打架，他可能会还手，另一个则会逃跑。有人可能会扇你一巴掌挑起争斗，另一个则可能朝你弹烟头，或把饮料倒在你头上。路人可能会为打斗叫好、逃跑或加入其中。有些人挨一拳清醒过来后就会停手，另一些人则会一直挥拳，直到被打晕。

paragraphs.en: No matter where you go in GTA 6, it feels like a lived-in world, on the macro and micro scale. There are over 100 interiors to explore, and each house tells you a story about its occupants. Listen to conversations out on the streets and you’ll get a window into their minds, built out by an entire Rockstar studio dedicated to making them authentic and believable, while still being larger-than-life, funny, and often unhinged.
paragraphs.cn: 无论你在《GTA 6》中走到哪里，从宏观到微观，这里都像是一个有人生活的世界。游戏中有超过100个室内场所可供探索，每栋房子都会向你讲述居住者的故事。聆听街头的谈话，你就能一窥他们的内心；Rockstar有一整间工作室致力于塑造这些人物，让他们真实可信，同时又比现实中的人物更夸张、更有趣，而且常常有些癫狂。

paragraphs.en: “A big part of it was establishing deep backstories for almost everything, even if they were never meant to be fully explained to the player, and then really sticking to those backstories,” said Steven Messinger, Rockstar's senior design director for the open world. “For example, our gang compounds have a complex drug network we’ve fully mapped out: where the drugs come from, who brings them in and how, how they’re distributed to each compound, what happens at each stop, and how they eventually reach the street-level buyer.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar开放世界高级设计总监Steven Messinger说：「其中很重要的一部分是为几乎所有事物建立深入的背景故事，即便这些故事从来就不打算向玩家完整解释，然后切实遵循这些背景设定。例如，我们的帮派据点有一个复杂的毒品网络，我们已将它完整规划出来：毒品从哪里来、由谁以何种方式运入、如何分发到各个据点、每一站会发生什么，以及它们最终如何到达街头买家手中。

paragraphs.en: “Players will only pick up on bits and pieces of this, but having that structure in the background as something we consistently refer to helps everything feel more real, like this big machine is always running even when players aren’t there.”
paragraphs.cn: 「玩家只会注意到其中的零星片段，但在幕后有这样一个我们始终参考的结构，能让一切感觉更加真实，就像这台庞大的机器即使在玩家不在场时也始终运转着。」

paragraphs.en: To build this tangible sense of place, Rockstar takes in-depth research trips for GTA games , embedding the writers in the mundane and the more extreme to really capture the soul of a city. Helicopter trips of the Florida Keys, ride-alongs with police, talking to people, taking photos and notes, all build up a snapshot that Rockstar bottles up to digitize in video game format.
paragraphs.cn: 为了营造这种真切的地方感，Rockstar会为《侠盗猎车手》系列游戏进行深入的实地考察，让编剧沉浸在日常与更极端的事物中，真正捕捉一座城市的灵魂。乘直升机游览Florida Keys、随警察出勤、与人交谈、拍照和记笔记，这一切共同拼凑出一幅图景，Rockstar将其收集起来，以电子游戏的形式数字化呈现。

paragraphs.en: “We had a lot of fun trying to capture the raw energy and vibrant chaos that Florida is known for,” said senior design director of world and population, John Macpherson. “By immersing ourselves into a number of these locations on reference trips, spending time with locals, experiencing as much as possible firsthand, we gathered a direct sense of what would make Leonida feel truly alive.
paragraphs.cn: 世界与人口高级设计总监John Macpherson说：「我们在尝试捕捉Florida闻名的原始活力与生机勃勃的混乱时，玩得很开心。在采风考察中，我们沉浸于这些地方中的多处，与当地人相处，尽可能亲身体验，从而直接感受到了怎样才能让Leonida真正鲜活起来。

paragraphs.en: “Everywhere you look, little stories constantly unfold. It could be as simple as what someone’s wearing, how fit they are, how they walk and talk, who they’re with, what tunes they’re blasting as they cruise down the street. We tried to match that in-game as much as possible, hopefully resulting in something that feels full of life.”
paragraphs.cn: 「目光所及之处，小故事都在不断上演。这些故事可以很简单，比如某人的穿着、身材有多健美、走路和说话的方式、与谁同行，以及他们开车沿街兜风时大声播放着什么音乐。我们尽可能在游戏中还原这些，希望最终呈现出一个充满生机的世界。」

paragraphs.en: You can walk along Vice Beach and see sugar daddies with their trophy wives, locals playing volleyball, tourists sunbathing, and people walking their pets. Everywhere you look, there’s something happening in Leonida, and it’s completely enveloping. You feel like a part of its world, rather than a godlike being with total control over it.
paragraphs.cn: 你可以沿着Vice Beach漫步，看到有钱男人和他们用来炫耀的妻子、打排球的当地人、晒日光浴的游客，以及遛宠物的人。在Leonida，目光所及之处都有事情发生，让人完全沉浸其中。你感觉自己是这个世界的一部分，而不是一个完全掌控它的神一般的存在。

paragraphs.en: There’s a mission around the midpoint of the game where protagonists Jason and Lucia people-watch from a hotel sunbed, inventing backstories for the guests by the pool, and it’s something I found myself doing as I explored the world and passed people by, such is the variety and diversity of the game’s NPCs. No other game has ever had such a colorful cast of extras, which is wild when you consider all this was built to add credibility to a world you can zoom past at 100mph.
paragraphs.cn: 游戏进行到中段左右时有一个任务，主角Jason和Lucia躺在酒店的日光浴躺椅上观察来往的人，为泳池边的客人编造背景故事。我发现在探索世界、与人擦肩而过时，自己也会这么做，游戏中的NPC就是如此丰富多样。没有其他游戏拥有过如此形形色色的路人角色，考虑到这一切都是为了让一个你可以以每小时100英里的速度飞驰而过的世界更可信，实在令人惊叹。

paragraphs.en: “We evolved from monolithic NPCs built to visual standards that were lower than the main cast in GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2, to fully fleshed-out characters with singular awareness and visual identities,” said Valmor Garcia, senior technical art director on GTA 6. “They are driven by dynamic moods, personalities, unique anatomy, facial features, and dialogue that are visually on par with our protagonists, Jason and Lucia.”
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA 6》高级技术美术总监Valmor Garcia说：「在《GTA 5》和《荒野大镖客：救赎2》中，我们制作的NPC千篇一律，视觉标准也低于主要角色；如今，我们进化到了塑造丰满的角色，他们拥有独特的感知能力和视觉身份。他们由动态变化的情绪、个性、独特的身体构造、面部特征和对话驱动，在视觉上与我们的主角Jason和Lucia处于同一水准。」

paragraphs.en: Rockstar built entirely new technology for GTA 6 to simulate hair, cloth, and the way muscles move under the skin. All that work is implemented equally across all characters, so there’s never that uncanny moment where you come face-to-face with a flat and lifeless NPC, staring at you with dead eyes. Everyone you meet is equally detailed, and the range of visual design is staggering.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar为《GTA 6》打造了全新技术，用来模拟头发、布料以及肌肉在皮肤下的运动方式。所有这些成果都同等应用于所有角色，因此你永远不会遇到那种诡异的时刻：与一个扁平、毫无生气的NPC面对面，看着他用死气沉沉的眼神盯着你。你遇到的每个人都有同等丰富的细节，视觉设计的多样性令人惊叹。

paragraphs.en: Of course, this approach created challenges in other areas of development. It’s fairly straightforward to implement a combat system in a game where all character models are approximately the same size, but the varied body types of GTA 6 meant Rockstar had to take a look at how it approached animations so physical contact looks good no matter how big or small the character models are. Especially since this is a game where the two leads can also change in size through diet and exercise .
paragraphs.cn: 当然，这种做法也给开发的其他领域带来了挑战。在所有角色模型大小大致相同的游戏中，实现一套战斗系统相当简单，但《GTA 6》中多样的体型意味着Rockstar必须重新审视动画制作方式，确保无论角色模型大小如何，身体接触看起来都自然。尤其是在这款游戏中，两位主角的体型还会通过饮食和锻炼发生变化。

paragraphs.en: “We decided early on that we wanted to really push the variation in character sizes and body types,” vice president of animation, Mark Tennant, explained. “This required us to establish a very robust way to share animations between characters while still resolving multiple points of contact, such as most vehicle interactions and grappling in hand-to-hand combat.
paragraphs.cn: 动画副总裁Mark Tennant解释说：「我们很早就决定，要大幅拓展角色身形和体型的变化。这要求我们建立一种非常可靠的方式，让角色之间共享动画，同时仍能处理多个接触点，比如大多数与载具的互动以及徒手格斗中的擒抱。

paragraphs.en: “Developing this workflow meant that we needed our animators to adopt new techniques compared to a more traditional approach. We also had to grow a team dedicated to overseeing the implementation, which required close collaboration with the art and rigging teams. All these aspects needed to come together to make it work, so it was a huge team effort.”
paragraphs.cn: 「开发这套工作流程意味着，我们需要动画师采用不同于传统方法的新技术。我们还必须扩大一支专门负责监督实施的团队，这需要与美术和绑定团队密切合作。所有这些方面都必须结合起来才能发挥作用，所以这是整个团队付出的巨大努力。」

paragraphs.en: It wasn’t just player-on-NPC contact that needed to be considered either. There are dozens and dozens of scripted scenes dotted about Leonida to find, the usual Strangers and Freaks of Rockstar games weaved into the fabric of the world, manifesting as wacky encounters of various size and scope. Some are one-on-one, but sometimes you become a spectator as two NPCs with opposing goals clash. If you decide to intervene, the game has to account for every possible permutation of that.
paragraphs.cn: 需要考虑的也不只是玩家与NPC之间的接触。Leonida各处散布着数十乃至上百个有待发现的脚本场景，Rockstar游戏中常见的「陌生人和怪咖」被融入这个世界，表现为规模和范围各异的古怪遭遇。有些是一对一的，但有时当两个目标相互冲突的NPC发生冲突时，你会成为旁观者。如果你决定介入，游戏就必须考虑由此产生的每一种可能情况。

paragraphs.en: “Shifting the centre of action off the player at times required a lot of careful thought too — if a cop is doing a stop-and-search on another criminal in the world, how do they behave if you commit a crime in front of them?” vice president of design Stephen Donkin explained. “Do they switch their attention to you? Do they compare the severity of the crime? If they come after you, what does the original criminal do? Does he drive off? What happens if you follow him?
paragraphs.cn: 设计副总裁Stephen Donkin解释说：「有时将行动的中心从玩家身上移开，也需要大量仔细的思考——如果一名警察正在世界中拦截搜查另一名罪犯，而你在他们面前犯罪，他们会如何行动？他们会把注意力转向你吗？他们会比较罪行的严重程度吗？如果他们来追你，原来的罪犯会怎么做？他会开车离开吗？如果你跟着他，又会发生什么？

paragraphs.en: “Every event, encounter, interaction had to be considered with this level of depth, as there are so many possible inputs to any given situation, and every new feature or mechanic that is added becomes a new input we must collectively consider.”
paragraphs.cn: 「每一个事件、遭遇和互动都必须经过如此深入的考量，因为任何给定的情况都可能有如此多的输入，而每增加一项新功能或机制，就会成为一个我们必须共同考虑的新输入。」

paragraphs.en: It’s astounding that Rockstar managed to keep this level of detail consistent over a full playthrough. Even 140 hours in, I’m still seeing new things and being blown away by the level of reactivity in every facet of the world, from Jason’s “mmm, chicken” when he kissed Lucia while she was tucking into off-brand KFC, to the police calling off a stop and search because I pulled my in-game phone out to record them.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar能够在完整的游戏过程中始终保持这种细节水平，令人惊叹。即使玩了140小时，我仍在看到新事物，并为这个世界各个方面的反应程度所震撼：从Jason亲吻正在大口吃山寨肯德基的Lucia时说的「嗯，鸡肉」，到警察因为我掏出游戏内的手机拍摄他们而取消拦截搜查。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 is a towering achievement made by a development team of perfectionists, and we likely won’t see anything quite like it until Rockstar does it again.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA 6》是一支由完美主义者组成的开发团队创造的卓越成就，在Rockstar再次做到这一点之前，我们恐怕不会看到与它完全相似的作品。

paragraphs.en: Just getting started in GTA 6 or wondering what to do next? Check out the Official Grand Theft Auto 6 guide right here on IGN. If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips and Chapter 2 Guide and Tips . If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map .
paragraphs.cn: 刚开始玩《GTA 6》，或是不知道接下来该做什么？来IGN查看《GTA 6》官方指南。如果你还在熟悉游戏，可以通过新手指南——67条提示与技巧了解《侠盗猎车手》的新系统，或通过第一章指南与提示以及第二章指南与提示了解前几章的全部细节。如果你已经开车走遍Leonida，想知道所有可以发现和完成的内容，请查看Leonida互动地图。
